601　市場營銷的角色601　Role of Marketing

對齊中五選修市場營銷管理 601（課堂筆記《市場營銷的角色》）。本章有：市場營銷概念、社會市場營銷概念、四步過程，以及策劃裡的六步。市場研究的做法見 602。 Aligned with F5 Elective Marketing Management 601 (class notes Role of Marketing). This chapter covers the marketing concept, the societal marketing concept, the four-step process, and the six planning steps. How to do marketing research is in 602.

1 2 3 4 4.1 4.2 4.3 4.4 4.5 4.6 5 6 7 詞彙Terms

學習重點Learning focus

讀完本章，應能：

After this chapter you should be able to:

1　介紹Introduction

貨品 或者 服務Goods OR services → 交換價值Exchange values → 顧客／公司customers／company → 利潤profit

市場營銷是指個人和團體透過創造和交換價值來滿足需要與慾望的過程。

Marketing is the process by which individuals and groups obtain what they need and want through creating and exchanging value with others.

例子：個人向機構交換。Miss Tong 用現金向餐廳換食物。

2　市場營銷的定義The marketing concept

重點在於 顧客（顧客導向）。企業應了解顧客的真實需要和慾望，並按他們的需要提供最合適的產品和服務（即顧客導向）以賺取利潤，並比競爭對手更能更有效率地滿足目標市場。

Focus on the Customer (Customer-oriented). A business should find out the needs of the customers (target markets) and try to satisfy those needs in order to earn profit and deliver the desired satisfactions more effectively and efficiently than competitors.

請茶改賣少糖Try Tea cuts the sugar

小美說學生不想再喝全糖。請茶先問清楚他們要少糖還是要茶味濃，再改配方。這是先看顧客，不是先把倉庫裡的糖漿用完。

Karen says students no longer want full sugar. Try Tea asks whether they want less sugar or a stronger tea taste, then changes the recipe. That starts from the customer, not from using up the syrup already in the store.

小練習 601.1Quick check 601.1

題 1Q1

個人和團體透過哪兩件事來滿足需要與慾望？

What should a business do with customers’ needs, and do it better than whom?

答案：創造和交換

Answer: find out and satisfy those needs, better than competitors.

社會市場營銷概念Societal marketing concept

企業不單要滿足目標市場的需要，也要維護甚至提升整體的利益。

A company not only needs to focus on corporate profits and customer needs, but also on the well-being of society.

社會Society 顧客Consumers 企業Company
社會(整體利益)Society (Human welfare) 顧客(滿足需求)Consumers (want satisfaction) 企業(利潤)Company (Profits)

3　市場營銷作為商業功能的重要性Importance of marketing as a business function

課本 P. 11–12。

Textbook P. 11–12.

  • 找出顧客的需要並決定怎樣滿足這些需要
  • Find out what customers need and how to satisfy their needs
  • 制定策略應付競爭
  • Develop strategies to compete with other companies
  • 與顧客、供應商、僱員和生意夥伴建立長遠關係
  • Build long-term relationships with customers, suppliers, employees and business partners
  • 監察及回應市場需要的轉變
  • Monitor changes in market needs and respond to those changes

4　市場營銷的過程The marketing process

[4步]

[4 steps]

第 1 步 策劃Step 1 Planning → 第 2 步 組織Step 2 Organizing → 第 3 步 執行Step 3 Implementing → 第 4 步 監控Step 4 Controlling

策劃市場營銷活動 [6 步]。

Planning marketing activities [6 steps].

4.1　檢討目前的表現Reviewing current performance

目的：評估其產品目前在目標市場中的位置。檢討市場營銷表現及財務表現來進行評估。可以將本身的表現與主要競爭對手進行比較。

To assess the current competitive position of a company’s products in their existing target markets. Through review of its marketing and financial performance. By comparing its performance measures against those of its major competitors.

評估市場表現：銷貨收益、市場佔有率。評估財務表現：投資回報、現金流量、利潤。

Common measures of reviewing marketing performance: sales revenue, market shares. Common measures of reviewing financial performance: return on investment, cash flow, profit margin.

4.2　進行強弱機危分析Conducting SWOT analysis

目的：仔細分析企業現時面對的外在環境及內在情況，幫助企業訂立市場目標。

Analyze the internal and external environment of the company. help firms set marketing objective.

課本練習：P. 31 Q17(a)。

Textbook exercise: P. 31 Q17(a).

內在Internal

例子：財務資源、企業形象、地點、生產設備, 研究與開發。

e.g. financial resources, company image, research & development, location, and production facilities

外在External

例子：供應商、顧客、競爭。地方的經濟, 政治, 科技, 法治, 社會及文化環境等等

e.g. micro-environmental factors: suppliers, marketing intermediaries, customers, competitors & public

macro-environmental factors: demographic, economic, physical, technological, political, legal, social & cultural forces

正面Positive 負面Negative
內在Internal

Strengths 強項：有助企業達成目標的內在優勢。酒店：房外景觀優美。麥當勞：商譽良好，市場佔有率高。

Strengths: Internal capabilities that may help a company reach its objectives. Hotel: Luxurious rooms. (McDonald’s) extensive distribution, high brand recognition, average price.

Weaknesses 弱項：可能阻礙企業達成目標的內在因素。酒店：地理位置: 距離機場較遠。麥當勞：食品較不健康。

Weaknesses: Internal limitations that may adversely affect a company’s ability to achieve its objectives. Hotel: distant from airport. (McDonald’s) unhealthy products, difficult to implement revolution ∵ large scale.
外在External

Opportunities 機會：對企業有利的外在因素。酒店：奧運舉辦。麥當勞：新興市場（中國, 中東等）。

Opportunities: External factors that the company may enrich its competitive advantage. Hotel: Olympic Games. (McDonald’s) Emerging markets (China, India, Middle East).

Threats 危機：目前和可能出現，或會影響企業表現的外在不利因素。酒店：通脹。麥當勞：人民開始著重健康問題。

Threats: Current and emerging external factors that may challenge the company’s performance. Hotel: Inflation. (McDonald’s) The rising public awareness of being healthy & pursuing nutritious food.
請茶的四格Try Tea in four boxes

小麗的店在學校門口，下課人流多，這是內在優勢。雪櫃舊了，這是內在因素。附近新開一間便利店賣瓶裝茶，這是外在不利因素。學校禁止含糖飲品的消息如果還沒實行，也可以是機會：請茶可以先改無糖。

Eslyn’s shop is at the school gate, so after-school traffic is an internal capability. An old fridge is an internal limitation. A new convenience store selling bottled tea is a current external factor. A school rule against sugary drinks, before it starts, can also be an external factor the shop can use by switching to unsweetened tea.

4.3　訂立市場營銷目標 (SMART)Setting marketing objectives (SMART)

引導企業進行市場營銷活動及成為監控市場營銷活動的準則。

Setting objectives guide the marketing operations and provide a standard for controlling purposes.

  • 市場表現：下一年銷貨收益增加１０％
  • Marketing performance: increasing sales revenue by 10% over the next year
  • 財務表現：下一年利潤增加１０％
  • Financial performance: increasing net profits by 15% over the next year

4.4　研究及選定目標市場Researching and selecting target markets

例子：百佳、Citysuper、ThreeSixty。

Examples: PARKnSHOP, Citysuper, ThreeSixty.

  1. 評估每一個細分市場（市場組別）的吸引力。市場組別是指一組擁有共同特徵的顧客。
  2. To assess the attractiveness of each market segment. A marketing segment is a sub-group of customers who share similar patterns of buying behaviour.
  3. 選取最適合的細分市場（又稱「市場組別」）作目標市場。
  4. To select the most promising segment (i.e., target market) to serve.

4.5　制定市場營銷策略Developing marketing strategies

目的：鞏固和提升企業在市場的競爭位置。課本 P. 17。

Objective: to maintain and enhance the company’s competitive position. Textbook P. 17.

角色Position 定義Definition 使用的策略Strategies used
市場領導者Market leader 某市場中市場佔有率最高的企業a company with the highest market share in the relevant market 擴展整體市場；保持現有市場佔有率；增加市場佔有率Expanding total market; Protecting current market share; Increasing market share through product extension
市場挑戰者Market challenger 市場佔有率比市場領導者高／低的企業，試圖爭奪競爭對手的市場佔有率a company with a lower market share than the market leader and is aggressively trying to obtain its competitors’ market share 攻擊市場領導者；攻擊其他弱勢的競爭對手Attacking the market leader; Attacking other weaker competitors
市場追隨者Market follower 一些滿足於現時市場佔有率的企業a company that is satisfied with its existing market share 開發與主要品牌產品相似的產品launch products that are similar to the leading brand
市場補缺者Market nicher 專門服務一個或數個細小市場組別的企業a small company specialising in serving one or a few small market segments 這些市場太小，難以吸引大型企業Avoid direct competition with large companies by serving one small market segments

例子Examples

  • Apple：不斷推出新版本的iphone (產品)
  • Apple introduce iPad series. (Product)
  • Coca-Cola：分銷方法多樣化, 顧客能容易買到產品 (分銷)
  • Coca-Cola making its products easily available. (Place)
  • PARKnSHOP：低價策略 (價格)
  • PARKnSHOP low price strategy (Price)
  • Colgate：不斷推出不同功效的牙膏 (產品)
  • Colgate launching various toothpaste formulae (Product)
  • Circle K：希望在便利店市場中取得一定的市場佔有率(從7-eleven)；建立特別的推銷策略 (幸福星LUCKY STAR 紙巾)
  • Circle K tried to capture market shares from 7-eleven by emphasising there is not only one convenience store in Hong Kong. Circle K gave ‘lucky star’ pocket tissue as a gift. (Promotion). Fairwood: e.g. Fairwood – redesign layout.
  • Tango vs Tempo (產品)；7ways vs 7days
  • Tango vs Tempo (Product)；7ways vs 7days
  • Crocs：推出經典 克駱格鞋 (產品)
  • Crocs introduce clogs (Product).
請茶不是領導者Try Tea is not the leader

屯門茶飲店裡，連鎖店的杯數最高。請茶只做學校門口、少糖、可自攜杯。它服務的是一個細小組別，不是去攻擊全港最高佔有率的品牌。

Among Tuen Mun tea shops, the chain sells the most cups. Try Tea only serves the school gate, with less sugar and a bring-your-own-cup option. That is one small segment, not an attack on the brand with the highest share.

4.6　制定市場營銷計劃 管理Formulating a marketing plan for management

詳列執行市場營銷策略所需進行的所有活動。這是重要的因為它引導了市場目的。

Spell out all the activities required for the proper implementation of the marketing strategies in detail. It is important as it guides the achievement of the stated marketing objectives.

要考慮：達成目標的支出、預算（收入、支出、利潤）、市場營銷組合 4Ps。

Decisions: marketing expenditures, budget (projected revenues + costs + profits), marketing mix, 4Ps.

計劃裡的哪一步Which planning step 內容Content
第１及２步Step 1 & 2 情景分析：分析強項及弱項，找出機會及威脅。Situational analysis. [current performance , SWOT analysis]
第３步Step 3 市場營銷目的：銷貨收益、市場佔有率及利潤。Marketing objectives: sales volume, market share and profits.
第４步Step 4 選定目標市場。Selecting the target market.
第５步Step 5 設計市場營銷組合（產品、價格、宣傳、地點）。Proposed marketing mix: product, price, promotion, place.

預算 (%)：市場研究 30%；推銷 70%。

Budget (in %) market research 30%. Promotion 70%.

監控 (何時? 建議? 期限?)：監控計畫的過程及在需要時採取糾正行動。

Controls (when? Specify the deadline and remedial actions).

5　管理市場營銷活動Organizing marketing activities

課本 P. 22–24。

Textbook P. 22–24.

企業要達成既定的市場營銷目標，首先要為市場營銷部門訂立組織架構，以將市場營銷活動進行分類和整合，並協調各項市場營銷活動。

It is the process of creating an organizational structure to divide, group, and coordinate marketing activities in order to achieve the stated marketing objectives.

組織類型Type of organization 經理角色Role of the managers 例子Example
職能組織Functional organisation 區域經理須負責管理某職能的部分Functional managers look after their respective functional areas
區域組織Geographical organisation 區域經理須負責管理某區域的部分Regional managers look after their respective individual regional markets Unilever
產品組織Product organization / product-management organization 區域經理須負責管理某產品類別的部分Product managers look after their respective groups of products Kraft / Procter and Gamble (P&G)
市場管理組織Customer-type organization / Market-management organization 市場營銷經理負責管轄不同類別的顧客群Managers look after their respective customer groups IBM / Xerox

6　執行市場營銷活動Implementing marketing activities

將市場營銷策略及計劃轉化成相關的市場營銷活動。

It is the process of translating marketing strategies and plans into corresponding marketing actions.

  • 資源的可行性：計劃得恰當？可行？不切實際的目標？太高?
  • Soundness of the marketing plan. Too high
  • 資源的可用性：足夠的資源（人力資源、財務資源、技術支援）？
  • Availability of the required resources. Not enough resources for promotion autocratic.
  • 市場經理的領導能力
  • Leadership skills of the marketing manager

7　監控市場營銷活動Controlling marketing activities

監控企業的市場營銷活動，確保活動能依照計劃順利進行。如實際表現不能達到可接受的範圍，便應採取行動作出糾正。

Monitoring activities to ensure that they are being carried out as planned. Taking necessary actions to correct all the identified significant deviations.

例子：[麥當勞]

Case: [case: fast food chain store]

  1. 訂立表現標準。[在一年內設定了銷售目標, 例上升20%]

    Set performance or target standards. [set sales target within one year]

  2. 量度實際的市場營銷表現。[量度那一年的銷售額]

    Measure actual marketing performance. [measure sales target within that year]

  3. 比較實際表現與標準。分析到底實際銷售表現能不能達到可接受的差異範圍。（實際銷量: 增加5%）

    Compare the actual marketing performance against the target standard. [determine if the actual sales performance falls within the acceptable range of variation (e.g., + 5% as predetermined by the fast food chain store)]

  4. 差異很大？[如果超出可接受範圍……] 第四步 (a) 採取糾正行動。第四步 (b) 不採取行動。為未來計劃。

    Is the deviation significant? [If the variation identified in step 3 falls beyond the acceptable range of variation, the fast food chain store should…] Step 4(a) take corrective actions. Step 4(b) take no action. Input for future planning.

小練習 601.2Quick check 601.2

題 1Q1

請茶定了「下一年銷貨收益增加 10%」。實際只增加 5%，而且超出可接受範圍。監控四步裡，下一步是 (a) 還是 (b)？

Try Tea set a 10% sales-revenue rise. Actual sales rose 5%, beyond the acceptable range. Is the next controlling step (a) or (b)?

答案：第四步 (a) 採取糾正行動

Answer: Step 4(a) take corrective actions
